materials.title: A delayed supply order
materials.transcript:
M: Did the replacement labels arrive? We need them for this afternoon’s packing run.
W: Not yet. The supplier sent the cartons to our former warehouse address.
M: Can they redirect them today?
W: They can bring them to the new site by Thursday morning. I will alert the packing team.

materials.title: Staff briefing
materials.transcript: Good morning, team. Our customer service workshop will begin at 9:15 in Room 204, not in the auditorium as listed on the first schedule. Please bring one example of a difficult customer question. The facilitator will distribute the new response guide at the end of the session.

materials.transcript: Passengers on the Green Line should note that trains will bypass Central Square this evening because crews are repairing the platform lights. materials.transcript: Thank you for joining the opening of our new Harbor Avenue branch. The doors will open to customers at ten, one hour later than originally announced, because the final safety inspection is still under way. Staff members should report to the side entrance at 8:30. Refreshments for invited guests are available in the upstairs lounge.

documents.label: Revised visitor schedule
documents.text:
MEMO — Visitor Services
The lobby tour schedule has been updated for next week.

Tours will begin ____ (1) ____ the east reception desk.
Guests should arrive ten minutes ____ (2) ____ the scheduled start.
The guide will ____ (3) ____ each visitor with a printed map.
Contact the desk ____ (4) ____ you need to change a reservation.

documents.label: Product newsletter
documents.text:
NEWSLETTER — Customer Updates
A new set of compact desk lamps is now available through the company store.

The lamps are ____ (1) ____ designed for small workspaces.
Each model includes a ____ (2) ____ adjustable arm.
Orders placed by Friday will ____ (3) ____ at no additional cost.
Customers may request a refund ____ (4) ____ they return the item within 30 days.

documents.label: Training-room notice
documents.text:
NOTICE — Facilities
The third-floor training room will be unavailable during an equipment upgrade.

The upgrade is expected to take ____ (1) ____ two hours.
Staff can reserve the conference room ____ (2) ____.
A facilities employee will ____ (3) ____ the new display before reopening.
We apologize for any ____ (4) ____ this change may cause.

documents.label: Quarterly order update
documents.text:
EMAIL — Purchasing
The purchasing office has received several requests for additional supplies.

Please submit your request ____ (1) ____ the online form.
Requests received after noon may be ____ (2) ____ until the next business day.
The stockroom will confirm each order ____ (3) ____ email.
Thank you for helping maintain an accurate ____ (4) ____ of supplies.

documents.label: Schedule update
documents.text:
MEMO — Operations
To: All project staff
The weekly planning meeting has moved from Monday at 9:30 a.m. to Thursday at 11:00 a.m.. The change is necessary because the client review now occupies the Cedar Room. Please bring the latest project timeline. The meeting will still take place in Room 204.

documents.label: Recruitment notice
documents.text:
JOB NOTICE — Harbor & Co.
We are hiring a customer support coordinator for a regional logistics company. Applicants need at least two years of client-service experience and should be comfortable with scheduling software. Send a résumé and cover letter to careers@example.org by June 12. Interviews will take place in the second half of the month.

documents.label: Service announcement
documents.text:
CUSTOMER NOTICE
The downtown service counter will open at 10 a.m. on Monday because staff are attending a safety briefing. Online orders can still be placed as usual. Customers collecting a reserved item may use the west entrance after 9:30. Normal opening hours resume the following day.

documents.label: Invoice reminder
documents.text:
BILLING REMINDER
Invoice 4187 for the quarterly maintenance plan is due on June 12. Payments may be made by bank transfer or company card through the secure client portal. Include the invoice number with your payment. Questions about the service plan should be directed to the account team, not the billing desk.

documents.label: Event flyer
documents.text:
COMMUNITY DESIGN FORUM
Join local designers for a discussion of accessible public spaces on June 12 at 6 p.m. The event will be held in the Harbor Gallery and is free to registered participants. A networking reception will follow. Registration closes two days before the event.

documents.label: Facilities memo
documents.text:
FACILITIES MEMO
Window cleaning is scheduled for the west side of the office building on Monday. Keep desks near the windows clear of personal items by 8 a.m. The work will begin on the upper floors and move downward. Employees may use the east-side meeting rooms during the cleaning.

documents.label: Order confirmation
documents.text:
ORDER CONFIRMATION
Your order for 24 adjustable desk lamps has been processed. The items will be delivered to the Lakeside office on June 18. Report any damaged units within five business days. The invoice will be sent separately by email.

documents.label: Travel itinerary
documents.text:
TRAVEL ITINERARY — CLIENT SERVICES
Depart Union Station at 7:40 a.m. on Monday; the train arrives in Brookfield at 9:05. A taxi voucher is attached for the ride to the client’s office. The return service leaves at 5:20 p.m. from Platform 3. Keep the receipt for additional local travel.

documents.label: Policy update
documents.text:
EMPLOYEE POLICY UPDATE
Beginning June 12, requests for remote-work equipment must be submitted through the staff portal. Managers should review requests within three business days. Existing equipment does not need to be returned unless an employee changes departments. A guide is available under Human Resources.

documents.label: Customer web chat
documents.text:
SUPPORT CHAT
Customer: My replacement keyboard has not arrived.
Agent: The parcel was delayed at the regional depot. It is now scheduled for delivery on June 18.
Customer: Will I need to pay another shipping fee?
Agent: No. The original charge covers the replacement. You will receive a tracking update this evening.

documents.label: Email from Events
documents.text:
To: Mina
From: Events Office
Subject: Spring Supplier Forum
The forum will be held at the Riverside Center on June 12. Registration opens at 8:30 a.m. Please bring your printed confirmation. A vegetarian lunch can be requested by replying before June 18.

documents.label: Reply from attendee
documents.text:
To: Events Office
From: Mina
I have registered for the supplier forum and will bring my confirmation. Please reserve a vegetarian lunch for me. I will arrive by 8:45 and attend the 10 a.m. session on sustainable packaging.

documents.label: Supplier quotation
documents.text:
Quotation Q-284 — Harbor & Co.
A set of 12 adjustable work lamps costs $480. Delivery to the central office costs $35. The quotation is valid through June 18. Orders of 20 sets or more qualify for free delivery. Contact sales to confirm stock.

documents.label: Purchasing email
documents.text:
To: Sales
From: Jordan, Purchasing
Our department needs 24 sets for the new training rooms. Please confirm that all units are available and that the free-delivery rate applies. We would like delivery to the west entrance on June 12. The purchase order will follow after confirmation.

documents.label: Email
documents.text:
To: Project team
From: Mina
Subject: Review meeting
The review has moved to Thursday at 11:00 a.m.. Please read the draft report before arriving.

documents.label: Calendar notice
documents.text: Thursday, 11:00 a.m. — Cedar Room, second floor. Attendees: project team and regional manager. Bring the report and a list of open questions.

documents.label: Team chat
documents.text:
Jordan: I can attend at 11:00 a.m., but I will be coming from a client visit.
Mina: That is fine. The manager said we can start with the report summary.
Jordan: I will send my questions to the group before lunch.

documents.label: Order status email
documents.text:
To: Priya, Facilities
From: Supply Desk
Replacement chairs are scheduled to arrive on June 12. The carrier requires a signature. The order contains 18 chairs for the second-floor training area.

documents.label: Delivery schedule
documents.text: North loading bay — June 12, 1:00–2:00 p.m. A facilities representative must keep the bay clear and sign the receipt. Old chairs will be removed on the same visit.

documents.label: Message to facilities
documents.text:
Priya: I can be at the north bay until 1:30, but I have a building inspection after that.
Evan: I will cover the bay from 1:30 onward. Please leave the floor plan and receipt clipboard at reception.

documents.label: Workshop invitation
documents.text: The customer writing workshop will take place at the Learning Center on June 18. The morning session begins at 9:00. Registered staff receive a workbook. Notify Learning Services of dietary requirements by June 12.

documents.label: Room schedule
documents.text: 9:00–10:30 — Writing clear service updates, Room 3. 10:45–12:00 — Editing practice, Room 3. Lunch is served in the adjoining lounge.

documents.label: Registration message
documents.text:
Mina: I registered for the workshop and requested a vegetarian lunch. Could I join editing practice if I arrive after the first session?
Learning Services: Yes. Please check in at the front desk before entering Room 3. We will leave a workbook there for you.
